name: Shape H - Collaborative Strategic Reading (Comprehension Repair)
description: Reading lesson where cooperative groups move through four phases (Preview, Click & Clunk, Get the Gist, Wrap-Up). The 'Click & Clunk' phase explicitly teaches students to detect and repair their own comprehension breakdowns.
pedagogical_justification:
CSR makes comprehension strategies visible and teachable (Slavin et al., 2011; ScienceDirect 2025 meta review, 16 citations). Unlike Shape E, which assumes comprehension is a product of the task, CSR gives students physical tools (clunk cards) to deploy the moment they hit a comprehension wall. The four phases map onto a coherent cognitive sequence: preview primes background knowledge and sets a purpose; click-and-clunk trains self-monitoring and fix-up strategies (the core innovation); get-the-gist forces summarisation as a strategy rather than a task; wrap-up consolidates and generates genuine questions. It is strong for mixed-ability classes because the group roles (Leader, Clunk Expert, Gist Expert, Announcer) distribute the cognitive load across learners rather than leaving a struggling reader alone against the text.

The shape therefore moves: Lead-in (activate schema) → Preview (purpose-setting) → Click & Clunk (read + repair breakdowns) → Get the Gist (main idea) → Wrap-Up (consolidate + question) → Whole-class feedback (share findings, address common clunks). The teacher models each phase before groups work independently, then releases control. Stage times assume a 46-minute lesson.
main_aim_format: By the end of the lesson, learners will have used collaborative reading strategies to comprehend and discuss a text about [topic].

example_lesson_plan.header:
Objective:
By the end of the lesson, learners will have used the collaborative reading strategies of Preview, Click & Clunk, Get the Gist and Wrap-Up to comprehend and discuss an article about how bees help our world.
Teacher:
Ed Rush
Date:
[DD-MM-YY]
Duration:
46 minutes
CEFR Level:
B1
Lesson Shape:
H (Collaborative Strategic Reading)
Materials:
Article 'How Bees Help Our World', clunk cards (one set per group), role cards, worksheet for Get the Gist
Assessment:
Group Gist summaries, Clunk Expert listening check
Skills:
Reading

stages.stage_aim: To activate schema and set the context
stages.procedure:
- Display the article's photos of bees and flowers on PP. In pairs, Ss tell each other one thing they already know about bees and one question they have. 2 min.
- Whole-class feedback. Write a few of the questions on the board.
- Tell Ss they will read an article about how bees help our world.

stages.stage_aim: To set a purpose for reading
stages.procedure:
- Model the Preview strategy on PP: look at the title, subheadings and pictures. Predict what the text will say. Set a reading goal.
- In groups of four, Ss look at the title and subheadings only (no reading yet). They predict the content and agree on one reading goal. 2 min.
- Each group shares one prediction. Feedback.

stages.stage_aim: To read and repair comprehension breakdowns
stages.procedure:
- Explain: 'click' = I understand, 'clunk' = I don't. When you hit a clunk, use a clunk card.
- Model with the first sentence using the fix-up steps on the clunk cards: reread, read ahead, use the words around it, ask the group.
- Assign roles: Leader, Clunk Expert, Gist Expert, Announcer.
- Ss read the first section silently (1-2 min). Group discusses clunks and fixes them using clunk cards. 4 min.
- Ss read the second section and repeat. Clunk Expert collects the group's clunks. 4 min.
- Teacher circulates, addressing 2-3 common clunks with the whole class.

stages.stage_aim: To identify the main idea of each section
stages.procedure:
- Model Get the Gist: say the main idea in one sentence of ten words or fewer.
- Groups write a one-sentence summary for each section on the worksheet. 3 min.
- Groups share their gist with the class. Feedback on whether each captures the main idea.

- Individually, Ss write one question the article raises for them (a real 'I wonder' question, not a comprehension check). 2 min.
- In groups, Ss share questions. They review what they have learned and predict what a following section might say. 3 min.
- Announcer shares one interesting question from the group.

stages.stage_aim: To share group findings and address misconceptions
stages.procedure:
- Each group shares their best 'Get the Gist' sentence. Teacher records them on the board.
- Teacher addresses common clunks and any misconceptions surfaced during the Clunk stages.
- Discuss the most interesting questions generated. Which did the article answer? Which remain open?

- Individually, Ss write one sentence summarising the whole article OR one question they still have after reading. 3 min.
- Collect as an exit ticket.
